bundle.shortDescription: Disposable email with live mail and one-click verification codes
bundle.longDescription: tmpmail makes throwaway email addresses at several free providers, shows their mail as it arrives, puts the verification code in a banner with a Copy button, lists the verification link first, and previews HTML mail safely. It shares its inboxes and config.toml with the tmpmail command-line tool.
